metrics.name: weekly_active_users
metrics.definition: Distinct district staff with >=1 session in a rolling 7-day window.

metrics.name: feature_adoption_rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible districts that used a feature at least twice in 30 days.

metrics.name: time_to_value_days
metrics.definition: Median days from contract start to first sustained weekly usage.

metrics.name: sub_fill_rate
metrics.definition: Share of absence requests filled by a substitute before the start bell.
